y06.note: Dashboard format: S1toS2; per run R2 floored at 0; median over seeds per cell (person x position); median over cells, separately for toes-down (2 most negative positions per person, 12 cells) and other (36 cells). Seeds matched between compared experiments. r2_range = max - min of the raw (unfloored) R2 over seeds, median over cells (what facts_y01 F calls r2_range). D01 = D01_cleanpassive+autogain+equalweight for CH, HM, IES, JM and C01_autogain+equalweight for EG, YES. Dropout 0.3 bar = X00f on YES+EG seeds 0-1.
